(Japanese: 橋の上の攻防 Battle on the Bridge) is the 46th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Karuta battles Rūkamu while Ryouga goes to rescue Miruto.
After rescuing Miruto, Ryouga defeats Rūkamu and sends him flying.
Upon arriving at Karuta's village, Karuta refuses to go inside.
